result.rationale: The webhook handler calls appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body) with no try/catch or safeParse; a ZodError thrown in a Next.js API route surfaces as an unhandled 500 with no message to the caller, rather than a 400. The mechanism is visible in the diff and is a genuine (if minor) correctness/behavioral defect in the new endpoint.
